issuing_body: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Inspector General
title: Recommendation Tracker — Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Control Unit: 2022 Inspection
supports: HHS-OIG's tracker, last updated 2026-08-14, shows four recommendations from Minnesota's 2022 MFCU inspection.
Recommendation 22-E-06-042.01 (second-line supervisor) is Closed Implemented, closed 2024-05-16.
Recommendation 22-E-06-042.02 (increase patient-abuse/neglect referrals) is Closed Implemented, closed 2024-05-16.
Recommendation 22-E-06-042.03 (implement a comprehensive case-management system) remains Open Unimplemented; the tracker shows the last update received 2024-05-10.
Recommendation 22-E-06-042.04 (consistent/documented supervisory reviews) is Closed Implemented, closed 2024-05-16.
important_qualifications: The July 1, 2026 conditional recertification letter separately imposes current special conditions and specifically requires implementation of the still-open case-management recommendation.
Recommendation identifiers 26-E-07-010 belong to the Oklahoma MFCU 2025 inspection and must not be attributed to Minnesota.
